S3.spec: This function specifically unescapes the following characters when they are preceded by a backslash: {}()+-.*?^$[]\s (curly braces, parentheses, plus, minus, dot, asterisk, question mark, caret, dollar sign, square brackets, whitespace, and backslash itself).

 def unescape(s: str) -> str:

+    return re.sub(r"\\([{}()+-.*?^$\[\]\s\\|])", r"\1", s)
